meta.title: The Conservatory Homicide: Dr. Aris Thorne
meta.incidentLocation: East Wing Botanical Conservatory, Saint Jude Research Arboretum
meta.prosecutor: ADA Eleanor Vance-Wright, Special Prosecutions Bureau
meta.medicalExaminer: Dr. Rebecca Lin, MD, FCAP (Chief Medical Examiner)
meta.summary: At 02:46 UTC, security discovered Dr. Aris Thorne deceased in the East Wing Conservatory. Initial scene analysis revealed broken exterior glass, fiber transfers, and absence of mechanical trauma. Full post-mortem examination identified acute Coniine neurotoxicity with secondary acrylic fiber and DNA transfers on subungual scrapings.

intake.clinicalNotes: Adult male discovered in prone position on stone flooring of botanical greenhouse. Initial core temp 31.2°C at ambient temp 11.4°C. No evidence of major external hemorrhage or projectile wounds. Evident signs of acute respiratory arrest.

vaccines.evidentiaryRelevance: Mandatory laboratory research immunization clearance; validates authorized botanical biosafety clearance.
Excludes soil-borne Clostridium tetani neurotoxin as cause of acute muscular paralysis.
Demonstrates routine institutional medical compliance and regular clinic attendance.
Establishes physical presence at University clinic 10 months prior to incident.

diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Lethal concentration of Coniine alkaloid. Induces non-depolarizing neuromuscular blockade and terminal asphyxia.
No ethanol or volatile hydrocarbons detected. Excludes acute alcohol intoxication.
No fentanyl, morphine, oxycodone, or synthetic opioid metabolites identified.
Normal red cell mass and coagulation indices. Rules out massive concealed hemorrhage or preexisting severe sepsis.

diagnosticTests.quantitativeResult: BUN: 18 mg/dL | Cr: 1.0 mg/dL | AST: 26 U/L | ALT: 22 U/L | Troponin I: < 0.01 ng/mL
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Troponin I undetectable, conclusively ruling out acute myocardial infarction as cause of collapse.

diagnosticTests.referenceRange: Antemortem: 3.5-5.0 mEq/L | Post-mortem rises linearly at ~0.17 mEq/L/hr
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Post-mortem vitreous potassium elevation calculates post-mortem interval between 01:30 and 02:15 UTC.

diagnosticTests.testName: Conium maculatum (Poison Hemlock) Botanical DNA PCR
diagnosticTests.quantitativeResult: POSITIVE (Amplified rbcL chloroplastic gene fragment, 99.8% sequence match)
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Confirms presence of crude Spotted Hemlock plant extract ingested via stomach contents.

diagnosticTests.testName: Subungual Swabs (Right Hand) Short Tandem Repeat (STR)
diagnosticTests.quantitativeResult: Major male profile Julian Vance (16/16 STR loci concordant, LR 1 in 4.8 Trillion)
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Foreign biological material under Dr. Thorne's fingernails originates from suspect Julian Vance, proving physical struggle.

traumaPoints.label: Temporal Contusion & Scalp Surface
traumaPoints.finding: Minor focal contusion (2.4 cm) along right parietal scalp without skull fracture or intracranial hemorrhage.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Consistent with secondary fall against wooden shelving; non-fatal trauma.

traumaPoints.label: Conjunctival Petechiae Screen
traumaPoints.finding: Bilateral subconjunctival petechial hemorrhages absent. Sclera clear of mechanical asphyxia markings.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Excludes manual strangulation, smothering, or ligature asphyxiation.

traumaPoints.label: Fingernail Scrapings (Bilateral Hands)
traumaPoints.finding: Microscopic trace particulate and foreign epithelial cells recovered beneath right index and middle fingernails.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Contains synthetic navy acrylic fiber fragments matching suspect Julian Vance pullover and foreign male DNA.

traumaPoints.label: Pulmonary & Hepatic Tissue Screen
traumaPoints.finding: Moderate pulmonary congestion and cerebral edema. Gastric contents reveal partially digested herbal solution.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Pathognomonic indicators of systemic acute neurotoxin absorption.

pmiModel.corroboratingSource: Matches seized 01:45 UTC SMS and 01:52 UTC wristwatch stoppage

deathCertificate.underlyingCausePart2: Acute Respiratory Arrest due to Neuromuscular Paralysis
deathCertificate.otherSignificantConditions: Blunt superficial scalp contusion secondary to fall

intake.name: Julian Vance

belongingsInventory.description: Synthetic acrylic sweater with torn left sleeve seam and missing thread fibers
Seized during apprehension; battery active, burner SIM card installed
Contains Metro driver's license and employee debit card

intake.clinicalNotes: Living subject presented under custodial arrest. Exhibits tachycardia and mild psychomotor agitation. Physical examination reveals three parallel linear epidermal abrasions along left ventral forearm consistent with fingernail scratches sustained within past 6 hours.

diagnosticTests.quantitativeResult: 0.082 g/dL (Above legal threshold for motor vehicle operation)
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Mild alcohol intoxication present at time of arrest.

diagnosticTests.testName: Forearm Epidermal Scratch Swab DNA Typing
diagnosticTests.quantitativeResult: Mixed DNA profile containing autologous cells + major female profile excluded + matching Dr. Aris Thorne
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Epidermal cells within forearm scratch match Dr. Aris Thorne with statistical certainty (1 in 3.2 Trillion), verifying close physical combat.

traumaPoints.label: Left Ventral Forearm Linear Abrasions
traumaPoints.finding: Three parallel linear superficial scratch abrasions measuring 3.5 cm, 4.2 cm, and 3.8 cm with fresh erythema and zero scab formation.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Inflicted by human fingernails during close struggle; antemortem defense injury corroborating Thorne's subungual scrapings.

dialogueExchanges.speaker: Detective
dialogueExchanges.text: Mr. Vance, where were you at 01:45 UTC when Dr. Thorne was poisoned?

dialogueExchanges.speaker: Suspect
dialogueExchanges.text: I told you three times already. I was at home asleep in my apartment. I haven't set foot in the conservatory since they fired me last month.

dialogueExchanges.speaker: Detective
dialogueExchanges.text: Then why does cell tower Sector 2 log your burner phone pinging 200 yards from the greenhouse?

dialogueExchanges.speaker: Suspect
dialogueExchanges.text: That's not my phone! You can't tie that burner to me!

confrontationOptions.title: Confront with Dr. Thorne's Subungual DNA Match
confrontationOptions.contradictionQuote: I was never within ten miles of Dr. Thorne.
confrontationOptions.confrontationScript: Dr. Thorne's fingernail scrapings recovered your DNA with a 1 in 4.8 Trillion statistical match, right where you were scratched.
confrontationOptions.suspectReaction: Suspect clutches left forearm, pulse spikes to 134 BPM, respiration turns erratic.
confrontationOptions.confessionYield: Admission of physical presence and altercation in greenhouse.

confrontationOptions.title: Confront with Shattered Glass Fiber Transfer
confrontationOptions.contradictionQuote: I never touched the conservatory perimeter fence or windows.
confrontationOptions.confrontationScript: The fibers snagged on the broken glass point of entry are an exact polarized light microscopic match to your sweater.
confrontationOptions.suspectReaction: Suspect swallows hard and looks away from detectives.
confrontationOptions.confessionYield: Admission of forcing perimeter window entry.

witnesses.name: Dr. Rebecca Lin, MD, FCAP
directTestimony: The decedent absorbed 3.2 µg/mL of Coniine, more than double the fatal threshold.
The death occurred precisely between 01:30 and 02:15 UTC as verified by vitreous potassium and algor mortis.
Fingernail scrapings showed defensive resistance and transferred foreign epithelial tissue.

crossExaminationQuestions.question: Doctor, could the decedent have consumed the botanical solution hours earlier?
crossExaminationQuestions.expectedAnswer: No. Coniine induces acute systemic neuromuscular paralysis within 20 to 45 minutes.
